title: Mobile Networks
description:
BETA VERSION, LET ME KNOW IF YOU FIND A BUG
This mod disables vanilla chat to add phones, and different antennas that you can create your own mobile network area to chat with people, as in vanilla chat but using the phone and your mobile network.
body: A mod that replaces vanilla chat to add a phone where you can chat ONLY if you are connected to an antenna that you have to craft, and then, name your network, or link the antenna to an existing network only if that antenna recieves signal from the other. You can check your connection with the phone, and choose your network.
